references.observed: Whole front:off-white two principal levels over low basement,small upper oculi,dark pitched tile roof,three-bay central giant pilaster order/triangular pediment and three roof statues. Ground windows have alternating triangular/segmental crowns;central door reached by steps. Separate park/fence/flags excluded.

Central three bays:four giant fluted pilasters,tall closed gridded windows,segmental ground-window caps,deep cornice/triangular pediment,round blue-gold clock and original simplified relief/statue silhouettes. Source does not reproduce inscription/heraldic art.

Rear aerial confirms complete U with main long hip and two perpendicular side hips,low wing-end pavilions/front service link. Rear main range has central slightly projecting plain three-bay upper range over a ground doorway and shallow semicircular terrace. Two rear roof chimney stacks,small rooflights and safety rail cues. Oval modern office is separate.

Oblique aerial distinguishes open court from rear garden and shows both full wings,three rows of smaller wing windows,hipped wing-end caps and southwest low attached service link. Thin freestanding park walls/guardhouse and oval office remain independent native structures.
